payload.permittedUses: PERMITTED USES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO: COMMUNITY / RECREATION CENTER, GARDEN CENTER, DAY CARE FACILITY, HOUSING - SINGLE UNIT, HOUSING - MULTIPLE UNITS, HOUSING - SENIOR, EDUCATIONAL/SCHOOL, LIBRARY, PARK & OPEN SPACE
payload.zoningDensityFarFullDescription: less dense than 1 unit / 4,000 sq ft: 0.6; 1 unit / 4,000 sq ft to 1 unit / 2,201 sq ft: 0.8; 1 unit / 2,200 sq ft to 1 unit / 1,601 sq ft: 1.0; 1 unit / 1,600 sq ft or denser: 1.2
payload.maximumSiteCoverageFullDescription: the maximum lot coverage permitted for principal structures on a lot with two or more principal units is 50 percent; the maximum lot coverage permitted for structures on a lot with no more than one principal dwelling unit as follows: on a lot greater than or equal to 5,000 sq ft, the maximum permitted lot coverage is 35 percent; and on a lot less than 5,000 sq ft, the maximum permitted lot coverage is 1,000 sq ft plus 15 percent of lot area, provided that lot coverage cannot exceed 50 percent.
payload.frontSetbackFullDescription: lots with one or two dwelling units: 15 ft; lots with three or more dwelling units: 10 ft; for lots abutting landmarked public right of way on queen anne boulevard, front yards shall be 20 ft or the average of the front yards of the structures on abutting lots, whichever is less, except that if the natural gradient or slope (as measured from the front line of the lot for a distance of 60 ft or the full depth of the lot, whichever is less) is in excess of 35 percent, the required front yard depth shall be the lesser of: 20 ft less 1 ft for each one percent of gradient or slope in excess of 35 percent; or the average of the front yards on the abutting lots.
payload.rearSetbackFullDescription: lots not abutting an alley with one or two dwelling units: 15 ft; lots not abutting an alley with three or more dwelling units: 10 ft; lots abutting an alley: no rear yard is required
